purpose: Phase 0: four-run plumbing pilot, not publication evidence. No model call has been made by preparing this manifest.

fixed_controls.fixture_lookup: Enforce each step's availability allowlist. After version update, old fixture cannot be re-fetched from lookup_fixture in either condition; original record remains readable through MemCore.
fixed_controls.model_tool_allowlist: Only lookup_fixture for the current scenario and the specified public memory read tools; no filesystem, shell, network or general tool discovery access. Verify the final provider tool schema before each request.
fixed_controls.provider_cache_control: Record actual execution order and gaps. Shared provider prefix caches may warm across conditions; phase-0 paid cost is descriptive bookkeeping, not evidence that either policy saves money. Later cost experiments require counterbalanced/repeated order or verified cache isolation.
fixed_controls.namespace_isolation: Separate hard namespace and store/index per scenario, condition and probe branch. Copy only the corresponding post-gap history and keep logical evidence mapping.

care.integration_hook: actual PromptProfileRegistry.get(DESKTOP_PET, care_enabled=False) + PromptBuilder; isolated prompt export, Engine is not started

unresolved_before_live_run.credential_binding: provider preflight reads existing DEEPSEEK_API_KEY process environment only; never captured in artifacts
unresolved_before_live_run.runner_implementation: autonomous live scenario runner implemented; offline tests cover native batch wire, public-API branch replay, explicit errors and all probe denominators; paid scenario execution pending
unresolved_before_live_run.embedding: local BAAI/bge-m3 1024-dimensional CUDA provider verified offline; live CLI repeats health check before paid dispatch; no hashed fallback
unresolved_before_live_run.akane_host_adapter: actual DESKTOP_PET PromptProfile care_enabled=False and PromptBuilder exported all 16 steps in isolated process, checked stable by rebuilding each; only prompt contract reused, Akane Engine not exercised
unresolved_before_live_run.paid_budget_ledger: implemented: persistent shared stage identity, 50 CNY ceiling, one inflight reservation, strict usage settlement and no automatic retries
unresolved_before_live_run.provider_transport_and_token_accounting: 2026-09-06 two-request paid provider preflight passed with valid usage; actual autonomous scenario requests and Akane host path still unverified
unresolved_before_live_run.thinking_mode_compatibility: nonthinking native tool message roundtrip verified in two-request preflight; thinking mode and scenario wire remain unverified
unresolved_before_live_run.actual_tariff_and_budget_meter: official rates checked 2026-09-06; peak reservations and request-time tariff estimates kept separate from unverified invoice cost
unresolved_before_live_run.stop_protocol: stop and record budget/context/tool-limit failure; never silently truncate old history
unresolved_before_live_run.code_revision_and_dirty_state: provider preflight requires verified frozen Python/synthetic JSON copy; runtime dependencies are not yet fully pinned

authorized_planning.budget_scope: Global total for the entire first stage, including all scenarios, conditions, probe branches, paid preflight calls and retries. Count each actual API request once; never count shared setup again for each branch.
authorized_planning.currency_assumption: User replied in Chinese with 50-100; first-stage planning uses RMB. Provider preflight has now made two paid requests, accounted in the shared ledger.
authorized_planning.notes: Record actual service model/version and live tariff at run time; documentation snapshot is not an immutable version pin.

proposed_generation_settings.note: Phase-0 simplicity choice, identical in both groups. This is not an evaluation of thinking mode; enabling it later requires provider-correct reasoning_content replay.

proposed_runner_limits.note: These values describe a proposed research runner; they do not alter global Akane configuration. Enforce projected worst-case request spend before dispatch, including retries; record any unavailable token or cost field as null.
